text:
Kara (CS): FYI Sunrise Health just requested onboarding their in-house finetuned 13B summarizer to Redwood Private. They listed PHI handling, HSM keys, and VPC-only control plane. Also asked for a pre-renewal hallucination/regression eval. Can CS own coordination?

Ethan (AM): I'll get them to sign the DPA and confirm renewal timing. They're cost-sensitive; prefer A10G unless performance demands A100.

Sam (ML Eng): 13B with 512-token outputs at tight p95 will need profiling. Requesting: model artifact (HF tar or ONNX), tokenizer, 50 representative prompts, and a short latency trace from their side. Without that we can only estimate.

Rosa (Security): HSM + VPC-only is supported. Security needs: dataflow diagram, signed DPA, retention policy, and list of external integrations (EHR, ETL). If they expect zero logging, we'll need an exception for auditability.

Kara (CS): Can someone provision a 3-day Dedicated eval window? We'll try A10G first. If perf falls short we'll propose quantized 13B or a distilled 7B fallback.

OnboardBot: Intake ticket CS-2026-5021 created and assigned to Kara, Sam, Rosa. Provision ETA 1773303600.

Sam (ML Eng): Send them this curl to get tokenization/time data:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.sunrise.example/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"docs":["<note1>","<note2>"],"max_tokens":512}' -w '%{time_total}\n'
```

Ethan (AM): I'll ask finance for a rough cost band for A10G vs A100 for the expected 30 qps bursty workload.

Kara (CS): Action items: 1) Kara to collect artifacts from Sunrise (3bd). 2) Sam to produce perf feasibility note (3bd). 3) Rosa to draft security checklist and HSM steps (3bd). 4) Request Dedicated eval (provisioned ETA from OnboardBot). Marking renewal-risk: monitor.

Sam (ML Eng): ack. If they caneliver a local trace we'll have a fast answer on whether A10G is sufficient.

Rosa (Security): ack, will post checklist in the shared doc.
